member.name: T:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions
member.summary: Immutable configuration options governing the reading and parsing of CSV streams.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.Delimiter
member.summary: Column delimiter character. If null, automatic delimiter sniffing is used. Default is ','.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.DetectAndSkipBom
member.summary: Automatically detects and skips any UTF-8 BOM (0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF) at the very start of the CSV stream. Default is true.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.CandidateDelimiters
member.summary: Candidate delimiter characters tested when automatic delimiter sniffing is active.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.Quote
member.summary: Quote character enclosing string cells (standard RFC 4180 double quote).

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.CommentPrefix
member.summary: Prefix character indicating that a line should be ignored as a comment (e.g. '#').

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.HasHeader
member.summary: Indicates whether the first non-empty row contains column names. Default is true.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.TrimWhitespace
member.summary: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from each cell before parsing. Default is false.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.IgnoreBlankLines
member.summary: Ignores consecutive or empty blank lines without raising an error. Default is true.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.ErrorMode
member.summary: Stop or recovery policy when anomalies occur (FailFast or CollectAndContinue). Default is FailFast.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.BufferSize
member.summary: Size in bytes of memory buffers allocated during asynchronous pipeline reading. Default is 64 KB.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.MaxFieldSize
member.summary: Maximum allowable size in bytes for a cell before raising a security error. Default is 16 MB.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.TrueValues
member.summary: Text representations accepted as boolean true. Default: ["true", "1", "yes", "y", "oui"].

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.FalseValues
member.summary: Text representations accepted as boolean false. Default: ["false", "0", "no", "n", "non"].

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.NullValues
member.summary: Default text representations associated with null values. Default: ["", "null", "NULL", "\\N", "NA"].

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.AllowCommaDecimalSeparator
member.summary: Indicates whether comma (',') is accepted and converted on the fly to dot ('.') for decimal number parsing. Default is true.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.OnError
member.summary: Callback delegate invoked when a row encounters a parsing error.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.UseStringPooling
member.summary: Enables string pooling to drastically reduce memory allocations on columns with repetitive values. Default is true.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.TransformField
member.summary: Optional global transformation function applied to read strings: (columnName, readValue) => modifiedValue.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.DateTimeFormat
member.summary: Default date/time format when no local [CsvFormat] attribute is specified. E.g. "yyyy-MM-dd", "dd/MM/yyyy".

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.IgnoreExtraColumns
member.summary: Indicates whether extra columns beyond headers or model properties should be ignored (true) or trigger a TooManyColumns error (false). Default is true.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.DefaultHtmlSanitizeMode
member.summary: Default HTML sanitization mode applied to all string columns. If null, no modification is made.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvReaderOptions.ColumnMapping
member.summary: Dynamic mapping between C# property names (or base aliases) and the actual CSV file column names. Example: new() { ["CustomerEmail"] = "adresse_mail", ["VatNumber"] = "tva_intra" }

member.name: T:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions
member.summary: Immutable configuration options governing the writing and serialization of CSV streams.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.Delimiter
member.summary: Column delimiter byte used during writing. Default is (byte)','.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.Quote
member.summary: Quotation mark byte for escaping fields. Default is (byte)'"'.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.NewLine
member.summary: Byte sequence marking end of line (default is CRLF "\r\n").

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.QuoteStrategy
member.summary: Quoting strategy applied to exported cells (Minimal, Always, Never). Default is Minimal.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.WriteHeader
member.summary: Systematically writes column headers on the first line of the output file. Default is true.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.NullFormat
member.summary: Substitution text written when a null value is encountered. Default is empty string.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.BufferSize
member.summary: Buffer size in bytes for memory accumulation during writing. Default is 64 KB.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.EscapeFormulas
member.summary: Neutralizes text cells starting with '=', '+', '-', '@' or tab by prefixing them with an apostrophe ('). Protects against CSV/formula injection in Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice Calc. Default is false.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.WriteBom
member.summary: Prefixes the CSV output with the 3 UTF-8 BOM bytes (0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF). Strongly recommended for opening directly in Microsoft Excel. Default is false.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.TransformField
member.summary: Optional global transformation function applied to strings before writing: (columnName, sourceValue) => modifiedValue.

member.name: P:FlashCsv.Core.CsvWriterOptions.FormatHeader
member.summary: Optional global function allowing dynamic translation or formatting of header names during serialization: (originalName) => translatedName.

member.name: T:FlashCsv.Core.CsvErrorMode
member.summary: Determines the reader's behavior when encountering a parsing error.

member.name: F:FlashCsv.Core.CsvErrorMode.FailFast
member.summary: Immediately interrupts processing upon the first invalid cell or row.

member.name: F:FlashCsv.Core.CsvErrorMode.CollectAndContinue
member.summary: Logs diagnostics to the error collector and continues reading subsequent rows.

member.name: T:FlashCsv.Core.QuoteStrategy
member.summary: Strategy for enclosing values in quotation marks during writing.

member.name: F:FlashCsv.Core.QuoteStrategy.Minimal
member.summary: Encloses in quotes only if the field contains a delimiter, newline, or quotation mark.

member.name: F:FlashCsv.Core.QuoteStrategy.Always
member.summary: Systematically encloses all cells in quotation marks.

member.name: F:FlashCsv.Core.QuoteStrategy.Never
member.summary: Never applies quotation marks and fails if special characters are present.
